items.description: Analyzes historical data using Eclipse Business Intelligence and Reports Tools (BIRT) technology. Betfair API is used to create BIRT charts and reports.
Links Google StreetView camera perspective to the orientation of the notebook. When you tilt the notebook the camera turns up/down or right/left. Works with Firefox > 3.6 and a ThinkPad or MacBook.

Connected with the Walgreens Balance Rewards program, this fitbit application allow users to keep track of their activity to earn Walgreens points. With a 'steps' program, customers will be able to set goals and view progress of their activities, while earning reward points at Walgreens.
Movies worth watching. Current releases and upcoming releases of quality are shared. Features full-screen trailers.
Tweedly uses the Twilio API and infochimps to keep subscribers informed (via SMS) of their Twitter influence ranking.
The 99designs Tasks Slack Bot is a full featured graphic design assistant application in Slack.
Lets you see where scenes from famous (and not-so-famous) movies have been shot in NYC.
Twyric is the art of mashing up Twitter poems with Flickr images for contemplation. Twyric = Twitter + lyric.
This is Silverlight application that is designed for touch panels. It allows to plan your trip from one point to another using your fingers.
Mapping based search to find German holiday rentals. Compare to find by location, like nearest one to the beach.
TwitAku.com provides a Twitter service: Twitter Signatures which generates an image with user's latest Tweet message, follower and friends status
